about: Protocol record fields that are missing and waiting on a value, read by check:protocols (scripts/check-protocols.mjs). An entry here is printed and passes; a missing field not listed here fails, and an entry whose field has since been filled fails until it is removed. Never fill a value to empty this list; remove an entry only when the protocol's source gives the value.
